description: Queue one run of a monitor now, outside its schedule, and return the run (run_id, status queued). It costs one run, billed when it ends (at most the monitor's max_run_cost_usd); it works on a paused monitor too. 409 run_in_progress while a run is queued or running; 402 when the balance cannot hold the run. Poll monitor-run with the run_id.

monitor_id.description: monitor_id returned by monitor-create or monitor-list, example: '6f1d0c9e-0d55-4b8e-9a3c-3c4d9b8e2a10'.

name: monitor-trigger
title: Run Monitor Now
